name: glidea-web2api
description: Expose ChatGPT, Gemini and Grok web sessions as a local OpenAI-compatible Responses API.

scripts.test:e2e:extension: pnpm build:daemon && pnpm build:extension && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/extension.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:extension-daemon: pnpm build:extension && WEB2API_EXTENSION_DAEMON_TEST=1 playwright test --config playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/extension-daemon.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:extension-responses: pnpm build:extension && WEB2API_EXTENSION_RESPONSES_TEST=1 playwright test --config playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/extension-responses.spec.ts
scripts.test:smoke:chatgpt: pnpm build:extension && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/chatgpt-smoke.spec.ts
scripts.test:smoke:gemini: pnpm build:extension && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/gemini-smoke.spec.ts
scripts.test:smoke:grok: pnpm build:extension && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/grok-smoke.spec.ts
scripts.pack:extension: pnpm build:extension && mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/web2api-extension.zip && cd src/extension/.output && zip -qr ../../../dist/web2api-extension.zip chrome-mv3
